description: Analyze an agent wallet's treasury health: GBLIN/USDC/ETH balances, whether the ETH covers an exit at the live gas price, the redemption cooldown, and (if daily_burn_usd is provided) days of USDC runway plus a recommendation that keeps seven days of spend in USDC and treats only the surplus as a candidate for GBLIN. Free by default; metered at $0.003 USDC only when the operator sets MCP_PAYWALL=true.

_payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 PaymentProof JSON. Omit on first call to receive the 402 payment manifest.

daily_burn_usd.description: Optional. Average daily spend in USD (e.g. 1.5).

name: treasury.health

cooldown.description: Whether the redemption cooldown is active and for how long.

gas_health.description: Whether the wallet holds enough ETH for the next transactions.

recommendation.description: hold, rebalance_to_gblin or rebalance_to_usdc, with the reason.
